policy: All overrides must have inventory entries; existing entries remain pending evidence-based review. This inventory is not a claim that each pin is necessary.

overrides.name: uuid
overrides.reason: Temporary compatibility experiment: force UUID 14.0.3 globally to eliminate vulnerable UUID 8.3.2 in @lhci/cli. Lighthouse CI declares an older range; passing real Lighthouse job required before acceptance.
overrides.removalCriteria: If Lighthouse fails, revert this experiment. If it passes, review upstream compatibility and future targeted replacement; do not interpret passing once as long-term support.

overrides.name: follow-redirects
overrides.reason: GHSA-mrwp-f3q8-3g9p (CVE-2026-116689) affects follow-redirects 1.16.0–1.16.1; upgrade to 1.16.2 while preserving Axios compatibility.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove only after the dependency graph selects >=1.16.2 without override and OSV, pnpm audit, CI and production image smoke pass.

overrides.name: lighthouse
overrides.reason: @lhci/cli 0.15.1 and @lhci/utils 0.15.1 pin Lighthouse 12.6.1, which pulls puppeteer-core 24.31.0 and chromium-bidi 11.0.0 with vulnerable Zod 3.25.76. Keep Lighthouse CI runner and select Lighthouse 13.5.0 with Puppeteer 25 to eliminate vulnerable Zod 3 without a Zod major-version override.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove when a released Lighthouse CI dependency natively selects Lighthouse >=13.5.0 and security, Lighthouse thresholds, browsers and full CI remain green.

overrides.name: body-parser@2
overrides.reason: GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828 / CVE-2026-111181: body-parser 2.3.0 vulnerable to unauthenticated denial of service; major-scoped patch 2.4.0. Keep until Express 5 dependency parent resolves safe version and integration tests pass.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove only after upstream parents resolve body-parser >=2.4.0 naturally and full CI/security checks pass.

overrides.name: minimatch@10
overrides.reason: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 affects minimatch v10; redirect v10 range to patched v11.0.1 pending full compatibility tests.
overrides.removalCriteria: Remove once all v10 requesting parents select patched 11.0.1 without an override and CI passes.
